# Comparison of methods

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## When to reach for each

### Least squares

- When you want a first look at the data and a rough answer quickly
- When you need starting values for something better
- When the fit itself is what matters and nobody will ask for an interval

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Maximum likelihood

- When you need to say how sure you are
- When you have more than one candidate model and have to choose
- When the counts are overdispersed, or the errors are otherwise not the same everywhere
- When the result is going into a report or a paper
